notes.title: ⛏️Update 0.2⛏️ Added Customizable Dialog Speed + Photosensitive
notes.content:
Dear writers,

we rolled out a new update recently to our demo to have a few fixes for more comfortable experience. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43792215/77cd08322f9719e666b774ecf31663965f533320.png[/img]

[b]Below updates can be found in the [Setting] :[/b]
[list]
[*] Added customizable Dialog / Theater TItle speed.
[*] Added toggle to the photosensitivity, by turning off Thunder / Flashing option.
[/list]

Thank you so much, we are working days & nights off trying to bring more drama to all of you!
Please help us to share a few words to your friends about this project ! 

Join our Discord : [url=https://discord.com/invite/fqAtpENk5m]https://discord.com/invite/fqAtpENk5m[/url]

Bestest,

Papaonn,
Wintero.
